name: Hue to Hoi An
summary: The coast road takes about three hours by private car, longer by bus, and can include the Hai Van pass. Da Nang is the stop in the middle.

modes.note: Ask for the Hai Van pass only in clear weather. The tunnel is faster and duller.

modes.mode: Train to Da Nang, then car
modes.note: A pretty coastal rail ride to Da Nang, then 45 minutes to Hoi An.

seoTitle: Hue to Hoi An — car, train, and the Hai Van pass
seoDescription: How to travel from Hue to Hoi An and when the pass road is worth the extra time.

faqs.q: Can you stop in Da Nang?
faqs.a: Yes. The Marble Mountains sit on the road between Da Nang and Hoi An.
